posts.title: Day 11 · Dinner Reservation
posts.caption:
A cut-out shoulder and crystals at the toe are all the jewellery a black dress needs for dinner at eight.

The Daria dress in black and the jewelled Rock heels, on warm stone at golden hour with the brass doors open behind her.

The Daria sits high at the neck, with short sleeves and a teardrop opening at one shoulder. From the waist seam it runs close to mid-thigh. The Rock heels have a pointed toe and a fine ankle strap, with a row of crystals across the front.

posts.caption:
Walking in along the terrace at golden hour, the sea behind them and the stone columns just ahead.

Beside her, the beige Sean knit hangs loose from a crew neck, with worn-through holes down the sleeves and a ribbed hem. It sits over slim mid-blue Finn jeans ripped at the knee, with black and white low-tops.

A tip worth saving: wear the Rhea open so the drawstring waist and the Goldie's cut-out both show, and let the cropped Cassidy hem stop just above the trainers for a flash of ankle. On him, leave the Sean untucked over the Finn so the knit falls straight to the hip.
